entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: A planeswalker once utterly devoted to the god Oketra, who now champions her ideals across the Multiverse with one of her arrows as a spear.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God of loyalty and solidarity, slain in the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: The Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The event in which Oketra was slain.

events.summary: Oketra is slain in the Hour of Devastation, shattering Basri's world.
events.quote: When she was slain in the Hour of Devastation, his world was shattered.

events.summary: Basri takes up one of Oketra's massive arrows as a spear and vows to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.
events.quote: he took up one of her massive arrows as a spear and vowed to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.

relations.note: Utterly devoted to her for most of his life.
relations.quote: Basri Ket was utterly devoted to Oketra, god of loyalty and solidarity.
